bar.name: Four hand-written no-kit apps by a strong model (habits, workouts, budget, journal), blind strips at 412x915
bar.pin: baseline shots archived in molde-design/archive-2026-11-23; candidate PR #36 @ acf9312

biggest_gap: Split blind vote (one critic picked ours narrowly, one picked the baseline clearly) and two S1 bugs: the habits heat grid wraps to 4-5 columns on phones so cells sit under the wrong weekday, and pick chips in the row editor sheet never write their value.

acceptance.line: every demo program renders clean at 5 viewports, light and dark
acceptance.evidence: 15 apps x 3 sizes x 2 modes: no console output, no overflow, targets >= 44 px. But heat grid wraps to 5 columns at 412 and 4 at 360; at 200% text day labels and mood labels overprint; Escape/Remove in a sheet throws an uncaught pageerror.

No app words in render.mjs or molde.css. But guess rules misfire on a stranger's program: True/False buttons moved into the app bar, 'Year 2026' shown as 'Year 2,026', money() hard-codes Rs and en-US.

acceptance.line: edits and undo never lose data entered by the user
acceptance.evidence: Both critics: rows and settings survive new-app, edit requests, two Undos and ask-again in every path tried. Reload loses session data with no notice while Journal says 'Saved on this device only'.

acceptance.line: blind critic does not prefer the hand-written no-kit baseline on look and usefulness
acceptance.evidence: Critic 1 (bar shown first) picked ours, narrow. Critic 2 (ours shown first) picked the baseline, clear: ours has one stat row per app, a thin Journal, no heat-grid labels on first screen, mood chart words off the gridlines.

other_notes: S1: heat grid column wrap (render.mjs ~l.282, 4.5rem minimum for word cells under auto-fill); row-editor pick chips do not change the value, edit silently dropped.

S2: 'Late: 2 task ises' (todo.mo plural call); 200% text overlaps at 360/320; uncaught DOM error on sheet Escape/Remove; mood chart labels hand-placed; no persistence across reload; guess rules for app bar and thousands separators.

S3: 80 px chat strip holds one 56 px button; clipped last tab chip; no focus trap or Enter-to-save in sheets; empty inputs without placeholder; dead space on tic-tac-toe, quiz, reading. 208 checks pass but do not measure columns, overlap or page errors.
